newsItems.title: Perplexity trusts GPT-6 Astra with end-to-end systems
newsItems.summary: Perplexity uses Astra to write communications, change software, and monitor production systems, and checks in much less frequently than with earlier models.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 基础模型能力、价格和开放策略的变化，会迅速传导到整个应用生态。
newsItems.titleZh: Perplexity信任GPT-6 Astra的端到端系统
newsItems.summaryZh: Perplexity使用Astra编写通信、更改软件和监控生产系统，并且与早期模型相比，签入的频率要低得多。

newsItems.title: Obama urges Democrats to have a ‘clear plan’ for AI safeguards
newsItems.summary: Obama recently said that Democrats need to make artificial intelligence one of their “central agendas” and “have a very clear plan” to address concerns around the technology’s economic impact and safety.
newsItems.whyItMatters: 新产品与功能展示了 AI 能力进入实际工作流的最新路径。
newsItems.titleZh: 奥巴马敦促民主党为人工智能保障措施制定“明确计划”
newsItems.summaryZh: 奥巴马最近表示，民主党需要将人工智能作为他们的“核心议程”之一，并“有一个非常明确的计划”来解决对技术的经济影响和安全性的担忧。
